summary: Russian forces conduct drone strikes on Odesa and Chornomorsk, while Ukrainian air defenses intercept attacks. Intense combat continues in Pokrovsk with Russian infantry assaults. Ukrainian strikes target Russian logistics in the south.
key_points: Russian drones strike Odesa and Chornomorsk from the Black Sea, with one downed by Ukrainian air defenses (Source: @kpszsu/68274)
Russian tactical aviation active on southern front, targeting infrastructure (Source: @kpszsu/68315)
Russian strikes hit two tankers in Odesa port, causing fires (Source: @tass_agency/385092)
Ukrainian forces repel Russian infantry assaults in Pokrovsk, focusing on Grishyno sector (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68897)
Russian forces attempt infiltration near Vasylivka and Novooleksandrivka (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68897)
Ukrainian counter-battery fire destroys Russian tankers in Sea of Azov (Source: @eRadarrua/100794)
Russian drone attack kills civilian in Kherson, destroying educational facility (Source: @UkraineNow/82622)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue to target Ukrainian logistics and infrastructure, with drone strikes causing significant damage. Ukrainian air defenses have intercepted some attacks, but the threat remains high. The conflict in Pokrovsk remains intense, with Russian forces making incremental gains.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian forces have responded to Russian attacks with counter-battery fire and air defenses, but the intensity of the conflict suggests a need for increased support. The international community continues to provide aid, but the situation remains volatile.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces are using drones and tactical aviation to target Ukrainian logistics and infrastructure, while Ukrainian forces are focusing on counter-battery fire and air defenses. The conflict in Pokrovsk remains intense, with Russian forces making incremental gains. The international community continues to provide aid, but the situation remains volatile.
